name: Scrubness — SEO and website optimisation
summary: Optimising the Scrubness WooCommerce store (scrubness.com) for search: product updates, site clean-up, page speed, SEO and GEO content for every product, and analytics (GA4, Google Tag Manager and Meta pixel).
description: Scrubness is a scrubs brand (scrub tops and scrub pants for women and men) sold online at scrubness.com, a WordPress and WooCommerce store, and also stocked by Southern Uniforms. The work covers updating the products, cleaning up and speeding up the website, SEO and GEO content for every product, and analytics.
businessObjective: Update the products and optimise scrubness.com for search engines and AI answer engines (SEO and GEO): clean up the site, improve page speed, write SEO content for each product using the free tiers of Ahrefs and Semrush, and set up analytics with GA4, Google Tag Manager and the Meta pixel.
background: scrubness.com runs on WordPress and WooCommerce behind Cloudflare, with Yoast SEO, Autoptimize and W3 Total Cache active (checked 16 Nov 2026). There was no GA4, Google Tag Manager or Meta pixel on the site at that check. Keyword research and SEO content will use the free tiers of Ahrefs and Semrush. scrubness.com is one of the websites checked by Site Monitor.
responsibilitySummary: Product updates, SEO and GEO, page speed and analytics
responsibilities: Product data and product page updates
Website clean-up and technical SEO (URLs, categories, tags, sitemap)
SEO and GEO content for each product, using the free tiers of Ahrefs and Semrush
Analytics set-up: GA4, Google Tag Manager and Meta pixel
progressSummary: Mobile PageSpeed raised from 69 to 95 (LCP 7.4 s → 2.9 s) on 10 Nov 2026, with product updates, the barcode and SKU import and a site clean-up done. Next: keyword research, SEO and GEO content for each product, and GA4, Tag Manager and Meta pixel set-up (no accounts exist yet).
sourceNote: Status from the page-speed work record of 9–10 Nov 2026 (with live-site checks), project files dated 6–11 Nov 2026, Mahesh's confirmation on 16 Nov 2026, and scrubness.com as checked on 16 Nov 2026.

tasks.title: Full website backup
tasks.description: Took a complete backup of the Scrubness WordPress site (files and database) with an installer, so the site can be restored or moved if needed.
tasks.evidence: Backup archive and installer dated 6 Nov 2026.

tasks.title: Live catalogue export
tasks.description: Exported the live WooCommerce catalogue: 84 products (by style and colour) with 842 size variants across women's scrub tops, men's scrub tops and scrub pants.

tasks.title: Business and marketing strategy document
tasks.description: Prepared a business and marketing strategy for Scrubness covering the business model, platform, customers, resources, current costs, recommended investments, an initial digital marketing plan and a growth roadmap. Recommendations in it are proposals for management review.
tasks.evidence: Strategy document attached under Resources (16 Nov 2026).

tasks.title: Supplier barcodes and SKUs on every variant
tasks.description: Applied supplier barcodes (GTIN) to 218 variants and made SKUs consistent across 308 variant rows, retiring duplicate legacy variants. Barcodes are required for Google Shopping and most marketplaces.
tasks.evidence: Import file prepared 11 Nov 2026; applied to the live store, confirmed by Mahesh on 16 Nov 2026 (date applied not recorded).

tasks.title: Mobile page speed: PageSpeed 69 → 95
tasks.description: Raised the mobile PageSpeed score from 69 to 95 with the design unchanged (desktop 100). Largest Contentful Paint 7.4 s → 2.9 s, First Contentful Paint 3.1 s → 1.2 s, Speed Index 5.6 s → 2.8 s. Home, product, category, cart, about and colour pages were checked after the change and look the same on phone and desktop.
tasks.evidence: PageSpeed mobile results before (9–10 Nov) and after (10 Nov 2026); Work record of 9–10 Nov 2026, with live-site checks after each change.

tasks.title: Page-speed baseline audit
tasks.description: Measured mobile performance before any change: median score 70 across three runs, LCP 7.0 s, with the homepage hero background image identified as the slowest element.
tasks.evidence: Work record of 9–10 Nov 2026, with live-site checks after each change.

tasks.title: Homepage hero image shown immediately
tasks.description: The hero image waited about 4.9 s for theme scripts before showing. It now appears with the text and is preloaded with high fetch priority.
tasks.evidence: Work record of 9–10 Nov 2026, with live-site checks after each change.

tasks.title: Separate phone-sized hero image
tasks.description: Phones now download a small hero image and desktops the large one, using the theme's own phone background setting.
tasks.evidence: Work record of 9–10 Nov 2026, with live-site checks after each change.

tasks.title: Fewer render-blocking stylesheets
tasks.description: Stopped loading an unused icon stylesheet for visitors; the page now waits on 3 stylesheets instead of 10.
tasks.evidence: Work record of 9–10 Nov 2026, with live-site checks after each change.

tasks.title: Critical CSS through Autoptimize
tasks.description: Moved CSS optimisation from W3 Total Cache to Autoptimize and enabled critical CSS, so no stylesheet holds up the first view of the page.
tasks.evidence: Work record of 9–10 Nov 2026, with live-site checks after each change.

tasks.title: Remove the empty row under the homepage hero
tasks.description: Closes the remaining 50 px gap under the top section on phones.

issues.title: Confirm whether website prices include GST
issues.description: The 2026 price list gives retail prices excluding GST ($49.95 and $54.95), while scrubness.com shows the same figures as the selling price. Australian consumer prices must be shown including GST, so the intended retail price needs confirming.

issues.title: Analytics accounts and owners
issues.description: No GA4, Google Tag Manager or Meta accounts exist for Scrubness yet. Accounts need to be created under the business, with an agreed owner.
